_fixture: Synthetic example for UI development; not real data. Tables only, so t and indicators are empty.

algorithm.description: Ljung-Box, Durbin-Watson, Jarque-Bera and ARCH-LM tests on the in-sample residuals of a seasonal ETS fit to the imbalance price.

tables.ljung_box: Ljung-Box Q statistic, degrees of freedom and p-value at lags 1..K
tables.tests: Durbin-Watson, Jarque-Bera and ARCH-LM statistics with p-values

algorithm.limitations: Retrospective: parameters are estimated on the whole range, so residuals are never features. Statistics and p-values only, with no pass/fail threshold. P-values below about 1e-16 show as 0.
